verdict.summary: The 128-row road pilot is the exact deterministic floor-spaced selection from the pinned development-only source manifest. Every selected source row preserves all GT, ignore and provenance fields; only image path normalization and teacher_key addition differ. Cache records and reported preprocessing equivalence/timing identities independently recompute. This is a small CPU preprocessing QA artifact, not accuracy evidence or training integration.

selection_verification.selection_rule: floor(i*N/K) over image-name-sorted rows separately within original train and val splits
selection_verification.scene_scope_note: scene_id identifies source sequences. No camera-identity claim is made. The family count is a conservative grouping by uav numeric identifier and is reported only to verify split consistency.
selection_verification.sampling_limit: The selector is deterministic and label-blind but not random or scene-stratified. Two short train sequences receive no sample, and the sorted tail is not endpoint-covered. Therefore the pilot is unsuitable for accuracy or distribution claims.

raw_and_cache_binding.raw_path: Every selected row retains preprocess.raw_image=true, source_sha256, source_annotation_sha256, original source_frame and full annotation metadata. Image names are resolved to absolute paths before cache construction.
raw_and_cache_binding.pixel_version: The unchanged disk cache binds dataset SHA, actual source image hashes, row fingerprints, PREPROCESS_CONTRACT, HWC RGB uint8 shape, preprocessing source SHA values and OpenCV/NumPy/Pillow/Torch versions.

equivalence_evidence.interpretation: The cache replaces only FullFrameDataset._load. Original Mosaic selection/transforms, boxes, labels, ignore boxes, teacher keys, shuffle order and RGB-minus-128 conversion are reused and matched exactly in the pilot. Validation remains non-Mosaic.

performance_recalculation.boundary: Three serial passes over 96 deterministic train Mosaics with a warm OS filesystem cache. Cached records are still opened, sought, read, copied and SHA-256 checked. No forward/backward, optimizer, loss, DataLoader throughput, GPU, physical cold-disk, full epoch or production trainer is measured.
performance_recalculation.construction_boundary: The reported construction time excludes pilot selection and the initial load_dataset_manifest audit/hash pass. It includes the cache builder's source rehash, raw decode/preprocess, write, fsync and index publication.
performance_recalculation.conclusion: 14.4635364x is road-pilot preprocessing microbenchmark evidence only. It is not a training speedup or a basis for time-compressing training.

findings.evidence: The pilot sets purpose=CPU_disk_cache_QA_only_not_accuracy_or_training and formal_road_eligible=false, but retains training_eligible=true so the unchanged disk-cache CLI can reuse load_dataset_manifest. train.py does not enforce purpose or formal_road_eligible.
findings.disposition: Do not pass this 128-row manifest to the trainer or evaluator for accuracy claims. If production cache integration is later implemented, pin an explicit cache-QA-only or training-dataset identity at that boundary. This does not block the current standalone CPU cache QA.

findings.evidence: Floor spacing over globally sorted names covers 54/56 sequences and omits two short train sequences; it is independent of labels but not representative sampling.
findings.disposition: Use only for cache equivalence/performance smoke testing, never for accuracy, coverage or road-distribution conclusions.

findings.evidence: The 14.4635364x result is warm-page-cache preprocessing only.
findings.disposition: Production integration requires a separately switchable cache, exact input/order/loss comparison and end-to-end epoch profiling before any training-time claim. Do not auto-resume GPU training from this milestone.

final_process_state: No Python process using the dedicated road_yolo_venv executable was present at the final reviewer check.
